info.title: Hoplite Platform API
info.description: Source-backed agent execution for products built on Hoplite. Create an app, import files, start a thread, continue editing and download immutable results without a GitHub repository. The Direct API remains at /api. Requests require an organization-scoped credential; service credential writes require Idempotency-Key.

post.description: Create an app: the top-level Platform resource that owns sources, threads, previews, drafts and builds. runScript, previewPort, setupScript, defaultModel and instructions configure every thread in the app. externalId is your own identifier, unique per organization when set; metadata holds up to 16 KiB of JSON. idleTimeoutMinutes is the workspace idle default when an activity call omits one. sandboxImage boots the app's workspaces from a custom image, for example one with dependencies preinstalled; it accepts only image ids Hoplite has enabled for your organization and otherwise returns 400 sandbox_image_not_allowed. Requires an unrestricted credential with project:create. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same app.

post.description: Record explicit editor activity and set an idle timeout of 1–60 minutes. When idleTimeoutMinutes is omitted, the app's idleTimeoutMinutes applies, then 20. Saved source survives runtime termination. Preview polling does not renew this deadline. The worker archives after inactivity and active work has drained; storage failure retains the runtime for recovery.

post.description: Run an explicit command against a pinned immutable source in an isolated build sandbox using the thread's provider and current resource limits. The live thread workspace is not modified. outputDirectory defaults to dist. Editing/apply admission stays held until the build sandbox is confirmed deleted. A ready build has durable logs, a manifest and a gzip tar artifact. It does not apply source, perform QA or publish an application.

get.summary: Read a preview and refresh gateway access
get.description: Inspect the existing preview without starting it or resuming an archived workspace. Use the POST start endpoint with thread:update to start or resume. Supply frameOrigin as an exact HTTPS origin in the query. When a gateway URL exists, receive a fresh five-minute server-only credential. Relay HTTP and WebSocket requests through your authenticated backend; do not expose the credential to browsers. Responses the preview proxy generates itself carry X-Preview-State (starting, unavailable, not_found or unauthorized) with an unbranded body; relayed application responses never do, so your gateway can substitute its own page.

parameters.name: frameOrigin
parameters.description: Exact HTTPS dashboard origin, without a trailing slash.

post.summary: Start or restore a source-backed preview
post.description: Start the configured preview, restoring an archived source workspace when needed. Requires product access. Supply the dashboard frameOrigin. To replace an existing launch, also supply restart.runScriptSha256 for the expected command. A confirmed replacement returns preview.restart with the new launchId, deterministic runId and matching command hash; unconfirmed restarts return 503 preview_unavailable. Session callers also need X-Hoplite-Action: preview-start. The gateway credential expires after five minutes; idempotent replay returns the original credential, so refresh it with GET preview. While the preview boots, relayed requests answer with X-Preview-State: starting (202 for documents, 425 otherwise). This does not publish or validate the application.

post.summary: Queue a draft for integration into the app
post.description: Requires project:update and thread:update. Pin expectedSourceId to a completed run's latest source. The durable per-app queue performs a three-way merge against the current head. Automatic agent reconciliation is the default: conflicts start billable repair runs on the same thread while the apply remains queued, within a 15-minute total repair budget. Validation failures are returned to the agent; three identical invalid candidates stop the loop. Set conflictResolution to manual to return conflicts without agent work. Repairs expose run IDs and reports. Normal edits are blocked while queued; applied drafts are sealed. Unresolved conflicts leave the head unchanged and reopen the draft. To choose head or draft files for conflicts, provide resolutions and pin expectedHeadSourceId. Every retry must reuse clientOperationId. An applied draft is sealed; start a new thread from the app head to continue. Validation covers source integrity, paths, limits and merge conflicts; no application build or browser QA is implied. Applying never publishes.

post.description: Import up to 10,000 UTF-8 or base64 files, 8 MiB per decoded file and 32 MiB total, with a 64 MiB JSON request limit. Paths must be relative, unique and cannot contain traversal or .git, .context or .hoplite directories. Symlinks are unsupported. Set executable to preserve executable files. Equivalent files in the same app return the same immutable source. No repository is required.

get.description: Replay the events of every app in publication order: platform.app.created, platform.app.updated and platform.app.deleted, sources, applies, builds, the app head, threads, runs, messages and tools. Each event names its app in appId. A credential restricted to specific apps receives only their events; when its apps change, earlier cursors return 410 cursor_scope_changed and an open stream closes with that error. Pass appId to read one app's events from this feed; an app the credential cannot read returns 404 app_not_found. Pass cursor with the same filters; limit defaults to 100, at most 500. Events are retained for seven days; an expired cursor returns 410 cursor_expired, after which you capture a new head and reread snapshots.
